description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields on roll invoices, including invoice code, invoice number, invoice date, invoice amount, check code, amount in uppercase, seller's tax ID, and purchaser's tax ID
description_zh: 支持对卷票上包括发票代码、发票号码、开票日期、发票金额、校验码、大写金额、销售方税号、购买方税号等关键字段结构化识别输出
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-roll-ticket --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1Y2ryJKT2gK0jSZFvXXXnFXXa-438-934.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeRollTicket

parameters.help_en: Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; base64 is not supported)

parameters.help_en: Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB. Either this or the URL parameter must be provided. When using HTTP invocation, upload the binary image file in the HTTP body. When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
parameters.help_zh: 图片二进制文件，最大10MB，与URL二选一。 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body 中上传即可。 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
